text:
As I dive deeper into the intersection of product management and AI, one thing stands out: we can’t let tech jargon overshadow the human element of our work. I recently came across a piece about the alarming trend of hiring top positions without essential expertise (shoutout to the recent news on the UK industrial strategy chief). It’s a stark reminder that in leadership, understanding the core of what we do is non-negotiable.

When I transitioned into AI consulting, I realized that the most powerful insights come not from complex algorithms but from understanding the people behind the data. It’s about making decisions that resonate with our teams and clients, not just fitting into a technical framework. 

Let’s challenge ourselves to prioritize clarity and connection over complexity. How can we ensure our strategies speak to the hearts and minds of those we serve? Reflect on your own communication: are you leading with empathy or just leading with data?

diagram_spec.diagram_prompt: A comparison diagram illustrating the difference between leading with empathy versus leading with data in product management and AI.
